title: transcode.completed payload
description: Emitted by MTS when all renditions for a job are produced and checksummed. Consumed by MAM and HSM.

editProjectId.description: the render (EP-26.6) whose output this is: present only on the completion of an `editor.render.requested`, where `assetId` is the rendered asset (the command's `outputAssetId`) and the one rendition is its `original`. MAM creates that asset from it (media-editor.md §5.1).
